newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans up on CBOT, dryness.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans up on CBOT, dryness.

text.p: Argentine new crop soybean prices firmed in tight cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, up in the wake of a firmer Chicago and continuing dry weather in Argentina, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for cash May soybeans firmed $4 to $280. Cash sunflower seed benefitted from dearer soybeans, gaining $4 in Buenos Aires to $208. Lower than expected harvest yields and some quality problems due to fungus are also squeezing sunflower up. Cash wheat was steady to firmer in tight trade, with millers finding supply hard to come by. Bahia Blanca wheat was unchanged at $150. Cash maize was steady to firm.
